entries.clue: Excellent police officer has last of grub (6)

blocks.note: super = superintendent, a senior British police rank

annotation.surface: A top-notch policeman is praised for finishing off his food.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Has' just joins the two pieces; super is informal British shorthand for a police superintendent.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: superb and excellent both praise something as first-rate.

entries.clue: Boring minutiae Gavin broadcast (13)

annotation.walkthrough: 'Broadcast' reads as radio or television, which suits the surface of a dull presenter, but its job is to scatter the letters.

entries.clue: Famous rapper lost one thousand books (7)

annotation.walkthrough: 'Famous' looks like it describes the rapper, but it is the definition; Eminem is the rapper and M is the Roman thousand.

entries.clue: Scottish cry stifled by cheese roll (7)

annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: brioche is one kind of roll, a rich sweet French bread.

entries.clue: Call into question regarding containment of soft dog (6)

annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, though a rare formal word: oppugn comes from Latin for 'fight against' and means to dispute.

entries.clue: Wallpaper glue in previous time to adhere, finally (5)

entries.clue: Get a new entrance (4)
